jobs.name: 行舟短发
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A production FRONT HAIR sprite for OUR OWN Chinese cultivation portrait, a transparent modular painting. Image 1 is ONLY our own hair MATERIAL reference: copy its charcoal black, restrained warm grey fibre highlights, finely layered matte ink-wash lines and soft ink shadows. Image 2 is ONLY our own head PROPORTION/FRONTAL AXIS reference. Do not draw the head or its skin. Strict level FRONT VIEW: no yaw, no tilted head, no perspective foreshortening. Make the structural hair volume bilaterally balanced, same temple height and width, central axis straight vertical, crown apex centred. Natural individual strokes may differ slightly, but NO SIDE-SWEPT MASS or off-centre skull. Compact rounded crown, close to the real skull; not tall, flattened or wide. Clean separate FRONT layer only: the front scalp cap, hairline, short temple hair, specified bangs. Face opening, inner gaps, outside background all genuine TRANSPARENT alpha. NO face, skin, ears, eyebrows, eyes, scalp patches, neck, clothes, rear bun, rear ponytail, back-of-body hanging hair. Do not carve ear-shaped holes. Hair may naturally overlap ear positions. No glossy silver streaks, no photorealistic fibres, no 3D lighting, no background glow, shadow or flat rectangle. Full hair silhouette and flyaways with padding; no text or labels.
Subject: Male cultivator soft, elegant practical short hair. Gently combed restrained rounded top with a shallow centre separation and a few fine tapered broken bangs descending only into the UPPER forehead. A clean open lower forehead, eyebrows and eyes will remain fully visible. Close-fitting temples end near the upper ears. Soft smooth strand groups, small controlled contour variation; no thick sharp spikes, no shaggy messy modern anime cut, no inward curls, no long cheek locks. Symmetric frontal temple structure, balanced delicate strand direction.
